sets.title: Form the Participle
sets.description: Choose the correct past active participle
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильное действительное причастие прошедшего времени

items.prompt: Человек, _____ книгу, ушёл. (The person who was reading a book left.)
items.promptEnglish: The person who was reading a book left.
items.hint: Was reading (impf past) = past active. читал -> читавший.
items.explanation: Читавший: past active (impf). He was reading (process), then left.

items.prompt: Студент, _____ экзамен, радовался. (The student who passed the exam was happy.)
items.promptEnglish: The student who had passed the exam was rejoicing.
items.hint: Passed (completed) = past active from perfective. сдал -> сдавший.
items.explanation: Сдавший: past active (pf). He passed (completed action), then rejoiced.

items.prompt: Past active participle of НАПИСАТЬ (to write, pf): написал -> ?
items.promptEnglish: Form the past active participle of написать.
items.explanation: Написавший: past stem (написа-) + -вший (vowel stem). Who wrote/finished writing.

items.prompt: Past active participle of НЕСТИ (to carry): нёс -> ?
items.promptEnglish: Form the past active participle of нести.
items.explanation: Нёсший: consonant stem + -ший. Past stems ending in consonant use -ший, not -вший.

items.prompt: Гости, _____ из Москвы, привезли подарки. (Guests who arrived from Moscow brought gifts.)
items.promptEnglish: Guests who arrived from Moscow brought gifts.
items.hint: Arrived (completed, plural) = past active pf. приехал -> приехавшие.
items.explanation: Приехавшие: past active (pf, plural). They arrived (completed), then brought gifts.

minimalPairs.context: Студент, _____ книгу... (he read and finished it)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The student who read and finished the book.
minimalPairs.explanation: Прочитавший (pf): who read and finished. Completed action.

minimalPairs.context: Студент, _____ книгу... (he was reading, didn't necessarily finish)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The student who was reading the book (process).
minimalPairs.explanation: Читавший (impf): who was reading. Process, no emphasis on completion.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The girl who is singing a song (right now).
minimalPairs.explanation: Поющая: present active. She is singing NOW.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The girl who sang a song (earlier, in the past).
minimalPairs.explanation: Певшая: past active. She sang in the past.

sets.title: Transform and Translate
sets.description: Convert который clauses to past active participles

translation.prompt: The teacher who explained the rule (masc, nominative)
translation.explanation: Объяснивший: past active (pf, masc nom). Who explained the rule.

translation.prompt: A woman who lived in France (fem, nominative)
translation.explanation: Жившая: past active (impf, fem nom). Who used to live in France.
Приехавшие: past active (pf, plural nom). Who arrived yesterday.

translation.prompt: The dog that ran away (masc, nominative)
translation.hint: Ran away (pf) = past active. убежала -> убежавшая (fem, since собака is fem).
translation.explanation: Убежавшая: past active (pf, fem nom). Собака is grammatically feminine.

blanks: Мальчик, _____ домой, был уставшим. (The boy who returned home was tired.)
Люди, _____ здесь раньше, помнят старый парк. (People who lived here remember the old park.)
Туристы, _____ в музей, остались довольны. (Tourists who visited the museum were satisfied.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Past active participle agreement and aspect
explanations: Вернувшийся: past active (pf, masc nom, reflexive). Who returned home.
Жившие: past active (impf, plural nom). Who used to live here.
Сходившие: past active (pf, plural nom). Who visited.

errorCorrection.hint: Студент is masculine. Participle must agree: читавший.
errorCorrection.explanation: Gender agreement: студент (masc) -> читавший (masc), not читавшая (fem).

errorCorrection.hint: Написать is perfective. Past active = написавший (not a non-existent present form).
errorCorrection.explanation: Написавший: past active (pf). *Написающий doesn't exist (no present participle from perfective).

errorCorrection.sentence: Люди, пришедший на концерт, были довольны.
errorCorrection.hint: Люди is plural. Participle must agree: пришедшие.
errorCorrection.explanation: Number agreement: люди (plural) -> пришедшие (plural), not пришедший (singular).

errorCorrection.sentence: Мы видели собаку, убежавший из парка.
errorCorrection.hint: Собаку is fem acc. Participle must agree: убежавшую.
errorCorrection.explanation: Case + gender: собаку (fem acc) -> убежавшую (fem acc).

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: Present vs past active participles, aspect, and agreement
sets.descriptionRussian: Настоящее vs прошедшее время, вид и согласование

items.prompt: Артист, _____ на сцене вчера, был великолепен. (The performer who performed on stage yesterday...)
items.promptEnglish: The performer who performed on stage yesterday was magnificent.
items.hint: Yesterday (past) + process on stage = impf past active.
items.explanation: Выступавший: past active (impf). The performance was a process (not a single completed act).

items.prompt: Present active or past active? 'Дети, _____ на площадке, замёрзли.' (playing right now)
items.promptEnglish: The children playing on the playground got cold.
items.explanation: Играющие: present active (plural). They are playing NOW and getting cold.

items.prompt: Поезд, _____ из Петербурга, прибыл вовремя. (The train that departed from St. Petersburg...)
items.promptEnglish: The train that departed from St. Petersburg arrived on time.
items.hint: Departed (completed, arrived already) = pf past active reflexive.
items.explanation: Отправившийся: past active (pf, reflexive). The train departed (completed) and arrived.

items.prompt: How do you form a past active participle from ПРИНЕСТИ (принёс)?
items.explanation: Принёсший: consonant stem + -ший. Past active of принести.

items.prompt: Мы читали о людях, _____ великие открытия. (We read about people who made great discoveries.)
items.promptEnglish: We read about people who made great discoveries.
items.hint: О людях (prepositional plural) -> сделавших (prep pl). Made = pf past.
items.explanation: Сделавших: past active (pf, prep plural). Who made (completed) discoveries.

patternRecognition.question: What do these past stems have in common?
options: All end in a vowel before the -л, so they use -вший
patternRecognition.answer: All end in a vowel before the -л, so they use -вший
patternRecognition.explanation: Vowel stem (чита-л, написа-л, жи-ла) -> -вший. Consonant stems (нёс, вёз) use -ший.

patternRecognition.question: When would you use the imperfective vs perfective past active participle?
options: Imperfective = was doing (process/duration); perfective = did and finished (completed result)
Imperfective is formal, perfective is informal
patternRecognition.answer: Imperfective = was doing (process/duration); perfective = did and finished (completed result)
patternRecognition.explanation: Читавший = who was reading (process). Прочитавший = who read and finished (result). Same aspect logic as regular verbs.

blanks: Спортсмен, _____ марафон, получил медаль. (The athlete who ran the marathon received a medal.)
Дети, _____ в лесу, нашли грибы. (Children who were walking in the forest found mushrooms.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Perfective (completed) vs imperfective (process) past active participles
hints: Ran the marathon (completed, masc nom) = pf past active.
Were walking (process, plural nom) = impf past active.
explanations: Пробежавший: past active (pf, masc nom). Completed the marathon.
Гулявшие: past active (impf, plural nom). Were walking (process).
